title: BEAR Resource Error (Compact)
description: Compact schema for BEAR Resource error logging - exception as complete string

exceptionId.description: Unique identifier for this exception occurrence

exceptionAsString.description: Complete exception information as string (class, message, stack trace, file, line)

profile.description: Profile information containing XHProf, Xdebug, and PHP profiling data

xhprof.description: XHProf profiling data object with file property, or empty array if not available

xdebug.description: Xdebug trace data object with file property, or empty array if not available

php.description: PHP profiling data with filtered backtrace focusing on user code

backtrace.description: Filtered PHP backtrace focusing on user code
